why: A consumer needs one command that says what changes for its own imports and exits non-zero while a removed symbol is still imported. Rows alone are inert; the verb selects them by the app's import census.
what: New: packages/basalt-ui/src/cli/migrate/** and packages/basalt-ui/tests/cli/migrate/**. Rows are read from the package dir the CLI runs from: packages/basalt-ui/migrations/areas/*.json (the source tree, including legacy-1x.json) and, when present, the merged migrations/<version>.json a published package ships; a row id in both resolves to the areas file. Outside owns, one edit: replace the rel-7 'not implemented' stub for migrate in src/cli/index.ts with the dispatch to src/cli/migrate.
contract: docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md sections 3.2 (schema) and 3.3 (CLI); docs/v3/concepts/skills-agent-layer.md sections 4.1 (migrate line) and 6 (invariants 1-5).
exemplar: packages/basalt-ui/src/cli/doctor-upgrade.ts (2.x, being dropped: reuse its census idea only) and src/cli/help.test.ts.
change:
basalt-ui migrate --from --profile

[--json] [--check]. It scans the app (ts, tsx, astro, css) for imports from basalt-ui and legacy selectors, selects the rows whose from matches, prints what changes. --json has a stable documented shape including an unmapped list (a census symbol with no row). --check exits 1 on a removed symbol still imported, a legacy [data-mantine-color-scheme] selector, or an unknown storage or url key. --from folds chains: rows A to B and B to C resolve to A to C, so 1.40.3 sees the 2.0 and 3.0 rows at once. Unknown flag, a missing --profile, an unparseable --from and a scan of 0 files each exit 1. No network. Unflip the .failing invariants naming this Issue. Rule: none. Skill snippet: none (the migrate reference is v3-sk-8). Test: row fixtures inline, app trees built in a temp dir.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: Temp-dir app trees; no consumer repo touched.
acceptance: A row for an unimported symbol is not printed; a row for an imported one is
--check exits 0 on a clean tree and 1 with the symbol named when a removed one is imported
A tree importing a symbol with no row lists it under unmapped in --json
A two-file chain A to B, B to C resolves for --from A
Unknown flag, no --profile, bad --from and an empty scan each exit 1
node packages/basalt-ui/bin/basalt-ui.mjs migrate --bogus exits 1 and migrate --from 2.29.0 --profile bridge --json no longer prints 'not implemented'
